item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Slack integration for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent will support Slack in private preview. Teams can mention the agent in Slack channels to start or continue incident investigations in the place where responders already coordinate.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported a high-volume phishing campaign that used Microsoft 365 outage-themed lures to target organizations across multiple industries worldwide.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Cybersecurity IR Workshop: The workshop you shouldn’t miss
item.description:
Microsoft Security blog post promoting a cybersecurity incident response workshop focused on preparedness and response. It says the workshop shares practical insights from DART to improve cyber resilience before a crisis.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
